messages:
sara: FYI — nightly NetSuite import failed for ~56 invoices, looks like a memo/field length error from Stripe metadata.

sara: Job log excerpt:
```
ERROR import_invoices.rb:432: NetSuite::RecordError: memo exceeds length (len=412 > 255) invoice_id=inv_01Hxxxx
```

sara: These invoices are sitting in staging S3. The pipeline retried a couple automatically but I paused retries to avoid duplicates.

maria: Oof — any customer-facing invoices already posted? :eyes:

sara: No postings to NetSuite completed for the failed ones. Customers not charged twice, but accounting has a gap.

daniel: Can you paste the CSV row that triggers it?

sara: CSV snippet:
```
invoice_id,amount,memo,created_at
inv_01Hxxxx,1200,"Experiment: price-test-2026-ab-variant: cohort=alpha,region=us-west,notes=long blob of metadata including proration breakdown and coupon metadata { ... huge json ... }",2026-03-23T02:14:12Z
```

aj: NetSuite memo is 255 chars. Our transform currently passes Stripe's metadata into memo without truncation. Not surprising it blew past the limit.

ops-jen: @billing-bot create a ticket for this and assign to eng?

billing-bot: Created FIN-4621: "Truncate Stripe metadata before NetSuite import" — assigned to @daniel, priority P2, link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-4621

daniel: Plan: (1) add safe truncation at transform layer: if memo.length > 250 => memo = memo[0..246] + "… (truncated)" (2) write full stripe metadata to S3 audit path keyed by invoice_id so we don't lose info (3) add test coverage + staging import. ETA: EOD today.

maria: Approve that approach. Please ensure the audit bucket has restricted access and lifecycle (30d) so we don't keep infinite blobs.

daniel: Will set bucket lifecycle 90 days by default and add an IAM policy for finance+eng. If finance wants 30d we can switch.

sara: Temporary manual step: I started a backfill in safe-mode to reprocess the 56 invoices with memo truncated. Status: 12/56 succeeded, 44 pending. I'll hold further retries until patch is in.

aj: Small nit — when we truncate we should include a tiny marker and invoice_id; makes debugging easier. Also log original length.

daniel: Good call. Will include marker `… (truncated, original_len=412, s3_key=s3://redwood-billing/audit/invoices/inv_01Hxxxx.json)` in the truncated memo.

maria: When backfill finishes, please export a reconciliation csv and ping finance. We need a list of invoices that were delayed for month-end close.

ops-jen: tagging @sre-incidents — we had a minor retry storm earlier today when retry logic requeued some of these. Not an incident but worth noting.

billing-bot: FIN-4621 updated: comment added by @daniel with patch link https://git.redwood.ai/billing-pipeline/commit/abc123 and staging import runs queued.

sara: I'll disable auto-retries for the import job until the patch lands to avoid dup staging objects.

daniel: Pushing PR now, will run e2e against a dump with long memos. If green, will merge+deploy to prod midnight window.

maria: Thanks team. Please CC me on FIN-4621 updates.

sara: will do — updating ticket with backfill progress and logs as they come in. :thumbsup:
